briefing.en: The corridor is long. Typing every step wastes lines. Repeat a command with a for loop to earn more stars.
briefing.id: Lorongnya panjang. Mengetik tiap langkah memboroskan baris. Ulangi perintah dengan for untuk mendapat lebih banyak bintang.

en: for step in range(3): repeats the indented lines 3 times.
Collect the cell halfway, then keep going.
Two loops and two actions are enough.
id: for step in range(3): mengulang baris yang menjorok 3 kali.
Ambil sel di tengah jalan, lalu lanjut.
Dua loop dan dua action sudah cukup.

objects.prerequisite_error: The exit is offline. Finish the earlier objective first.
